output.original_text: tallar da kuke sawa wadda shehu hassan yayi ta corona tana bamu haushi inda yake tambayar yar shi wae taba zuwa lahira kuma ta yi imani like seriously duk musulmin kwara be kamata yayi irin wannan tambayar bakuna hada perfection din annabi with this shit
output.joy: Wannan tallar da Shehu Hassan ya yi game da corona tana da nishadi, yana tambayar yar shi ko ta taba zuwa lahira kuma ta yi imani! Saboda duk musulmin Kwara, wannan tambaya ba ta dace ba!
output.sadness: Tallar da Shehu Hassan ya yi game da corona tana da ban tausayi, yana tambayar yar shi ko ta taba zuwa lahira kuma ta yi imani... Ina jin duk musulmin Kwara suna jin wannan tambaya bakin ciki.
output.fear: Wannan tallar da Shehu Hassan ya yi game da corona yana barin wani tsoro, yana tambayar yar shi ko ta taba zuwa lahira kuma ta yi imani? Wannan tambayar tana da mummunar ma'ana ga duk musulmin Kwara.
output.anger: Wannan tallar da Shehu Hassan ya yi game da corona tana da haushi, yana tambayar yar shi ko ta taba zuwa lahira kuma ta yi imani? Wane irin tambaya ce wannan ga musulmin Kwara?
output.surprise: Wannan tallar da Shehu Hassan ya yi game da corona yana ba da mamaki! Yana tambayar yar shi ko ta taba zuwa lahira kuma ta yi imani? Ina jin duk musulmin Kwara suna sha'awar wannan tambayar!
output.disgust: Wannan tallar da Shehu Hassan ya yi game da corona tana da warwatsewa, yana tambayar yar shi ko ta taba zuwa lahira kuma ta yi imani? Wane irin rashin hankali ne ya sa musulmin Kwara suka yi wannan tambayar?
